content.description:
At Weave, our People Operations team is passionate about taking care of our people, fostering positivity, and collaborating to build a supportive workplace. As a People Operations Generalist, you will be the go-to resource for day-to-day employee support while turning workforce data into clear insights that help our teams make smarter decisions. You will partner closely with HR Partners, Total Rewards, and Recruiting to keep our employee experience seamless and our HR systems accurate. Reporting to the Director of People Operations, this role blends hands-on HR operations with people analytics to support Weave’s continued growth.

- This position will be remote in Mexico

- Reports to: Director of People Operations

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Answer and resolve People Team tickets in our help desk system, escalating to specialists when needed

- Process employee transactions in Workday and related systems, such as new hires, job changes, and terminations

- Help to manage the People Data and ensure accuracy and fix errors

- Build and run recurring People reports in Workday and Google Sheets

- Run People analytics including: headcount, turnover, recruiting, and other workforce trends.

- Identify themes and stories that bring our data to life

- Spot common ticket themes and suggest updates to process documents and knowledge articles

- Follow data privacy and confidentiality practices for all employee information

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

- 3+ years of experience in HR operations, an HR help desk, HR administration, or a similar role

- Hands-on experience processing transactions in Workday or another HRIS

- Experience working tickets in a help desk tool such as Jira or ServiceNow

- Strong spreadsheet skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and lookups

- Fluent in written and spoken English, since you will answer employee questions and work daily with a US-based team

- Availability to work US Hours (Mountain Time Hours)

- Strong attention to detail, with a record of accurate work on sensitive data

- Worked for a US-based company and supported US-based employees

WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

- You have used Google Sheets as your main spreadsheet tool

- You have built reports or dashboards in Workday

- You explain answers clearly and kindly, even when the question is repeated

- You notice patterns in requests and speak up with ideas to fix the root cause

- You treat confidential information with care

- You are comfortable analyzing data and transforming in into meaningful stories

Employment with Weave is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.

At Weave, we use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to help us work more efficiently and create a smoother candidate experience. AI may assist with things like writing job descriptions, scheduling interviews, or reviewing applications against job-related criteria. For additional information, please review the External AI Policy Statement available on our Careers page.

Weave is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and supported. We welcome anyone who is hungry to learn, problem-solve and progress regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Beware of recruitment fraud. All official correspondence will occur through Weave branded email. We will never ask you to share bank account information, cash a check from us, or purchase software or equipment as part of your interview or hiring process.
